turns.text: You try to, but I feel like that stresses you out more.
turns.zh: 你尽量，但我觉得那样反而让你压力更大。

turns.text: In the search for perfection you, you dig your hole deeper, do you know what I mean?
turns.zh: 在追求完美的过程中，你会，你会越陷越深，你懂我意思吧？
